routes.label: Find equal angles in triangle ABC
Find equal angles in triangle ABC

question: Quadrilateral \(ABCD\) is inscribed in a circle with \(\angle BAC = 70^\circ,\) \(\angle ADB = 40^\circ,\) \(AD = 4,\) and \(BC = 6.\) What is \(AC?\)
solution:
The circle lets us transfer the known angle at \(D\) into triangle \(ABC\). In the cyclic quadrilateral, \(C\) and \(D\) lie on the same side of chord \(AB\), so \(\angle ACB\) and \(\angle ADB\) intercept the same arc. By the inscribed angle theorem,
\[
\angle ACB=\angle ADB=40^\circ.
\]
The angles of triangle \(ABC\) sum to \(180^\circ\), so
\[
\angle ABC=180^\circ-70^\circ-40^\circ=70^\circ.
\]
Thus \(\angle ABC=\angle BAC\). Equal angles in a triangle have equal opposite sides, giving \(AC=BC=6\). Therefore \(AC=6\), choice \(\mathrm{B}\).
